route.name: AIGINA LOOP (incl. Aphaia Temple and Ag. Marina)

Turn slight right onto Αίγινας - Μεσαγρού, ΕΠ55
Turn sharp left onto Αφαίας, ΕΠ56
Turn slight right onto Αφαίας, ΕΠ56
Turn slight left onto Αίγινας - Μεσαγρού, ΕΠ55
Turn right onto Αίγινας - Μεσαγρού, ΕΠ55

points_of_interest.name: Prehistoric settlement of the 3rd Millenium BC with remains of Classical Temple of Apollo from the 5th century on your left
Bronze Statue of a Mother waiting for her son, who is a sailor at sea on your left
Turn left, but ensure that the street is clear
Turn left to the pier of Souvala Marina if you want to take pictures and drink some water
Turn right and shift into a low gear; immediately after the turn-off, there is a short steep climb.
Turn left, but ensure first that the street is clear
Long and partially steeper climb ahead. The road might be busier than before, please stick to the right!
Go straight ahead towards Aphaia Tempel
Leave your bikes on the parking place on your left and wait for your leader to purchase the entry tickets for the Temple of Aphaia for you. Meanwhile you may use the bathroom facilities of the Café.
Temple of Aphaia from the 5th century B.C.
Long descent of 5 km ahead with partially sharp curves
Follow the main road which leads downhill
Turn left down to Agia Marina Beach. Here you may enjoy a swim or a coffee break.
Turn left, but ensure first that the street is clear
Turn right to see the Monastery of Agios Nektarios
On your right you can see the hill with 30 of the former 365 medieval chapels of Paleochora
Make a stop to take some pictures of the famous pistachios trees on Aigina Island
Aphaia Temple Café with bathroom facilities and a beautiful view of the Saronic Gulf
Turn left and park your bikes of you want to visit the monastery
Turn right with caution, ensure first that the street is clear
Follow the main road - keep to the right
Turn left with caution, ensure that the street is clear
Turn left and go straight until you reach the boat
View Point of Agii Anagiri Chapel
Long steady descent to Aegina Town. Busy road, stick striktly to the right.
